## 🔧 Banco PT — Dashboard Técnico
Métricas de engenharia: latência, throughput, erros por serviço e análise forense.
**Serviços:** api-gateway · auth-service · transaction-service · fraud-service

1.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count()
1.title: 📊 Transações (5min)

2.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success")
| fieldsAdd taxa = round(toDouble(ok) / toDouble(total) * 100, decimals: 1)
| fields taxa
2.title: ✅ Taxa de Sucesso (5min)

3.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95)
3.title: ⏱️ Latência P95 (5min)

4.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.auth"
| filter status == "failure"
| summarize falhas = count()
4.title: 🔒 Auth Failures (5min)

5.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| filter status == "blocked"
| summarize bloqueadas = count()
5.title: 🛡️ Fraudes Bloqueadas (5min)

6.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize lentas = countIf(toLong(latencia_ms) > 1000)
6.title: 🐢 Txn >1000ms (5min)

8.title: Volume por canal ao longo do tempo (1h)

9.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{canal}
| sort p95, direction:"descending"
9.title: Latência por canal (1h) — ms

10.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), erros = countIf(status == "error"), by:{canal}
| fieldsAdd taxa_erro_pct = round(toDouble(erros) / toDouble(total) * 100, decimals: 2)
| sort taxa_erro_pct, direction:"descending"
10.title: Taxa de erro por canal (1h) — %

12.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m), error_code}
12.title: Erros por tipo ao longo do tempo (1h)

13.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), valor_perdido = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{canal, error_code}
| sort ocorrencias, direction:"descending"
13.title: Distribuição de erros: canal × código (1h)

14.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-24h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize total = count(), by:{error_code}
| sort total, direction:"descending"
14.title: Frequência de erros por código (24h)

16.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m)}
16.title: Latência percentis ao longo do tempo (6h)

17.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), lentas = countIf(toLong(latencia_ms) > 1000), by:{canal}
17.title: Latência por canal: P50/P95/P99 (6h)

18.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize lentas = countIf(toLong(latencia_ms) > 1000), rapidas = countIf(toLong(latencia_ms) <= 1000), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m)}
18.title: Transações lentas (>1000ms) vs rápidas (6h)

20.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-6h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| fields timestamp, txn = transaction_id, canal, error_code, valor_eur, latencia_ms, iban = iban_origem
| sort timestamp, direction:"descending"
| limit 25
20.title: Últimas 25 transações com erro (6h)

21.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(fraud_score)
| summarize score_medio = round(avg(toDouble(fraud_score)), decimals: 2), score_max = max(toDouble(fraud_score)), altas = countIf(toDouble(fraud_score) > 0.7), by:{canal}
| sort score_max, direction:"descending"
21.title: Fraud score: por canal nas transações (1h)

23.title: Auth: sucesso vs falha ao longo do tempo (1h)

24.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.auth"
| filter isNotNull(metodo_autenticacao)
| summarize total = count(), sucesso = countIf(status == "success"), falhas = countIf(status == "failure"), by:{metodo = metodo_autenticacao}
| sort total, direction:"descending"
24.title: Auth por método de autenticação (1h)

25.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| filter isNotNull(score)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toDouble(score), 50), p90 = percentile(toDouble(score), 90), p99 = percentile(toDouble(score), 99), by:{bin(timestamp, 5m)}
25.title: Distribuição de fraud score ao longo do tempo (1h)

26.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| filter isNotNull(regras_ativas)
| filter regras_ativas != "none"
| summarize eventos = count(), bloqueadas = countIf(status == "blocked"), valor_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{regras = regras_ativas}
| sort eventos, direction:"descending"
| limit 10
26.title: Fraudes bloqueadas por combinação de regras (1h)
